notes.title: Solution : the Bug of Only 'Knife' Selectable, Answer Choices Not Appearing
notes.notes:
Hello, this is 이솝(Esob), the current programmer in charge!

I received the save data from TOZZI and have identified where the issue is occurring. Thank you, TOZZI, for providing the save data.

First, I will guide you through the steps to resolve this issue.

During gameplay, there may be instances where the file cabinet closes like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212780/f85874bed1f84f0a76a18eaa0c2ff63452a377cf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212780/bde5c93907d81872dd50c3ed23cf4a0608fc58e3.png[/img]

Please open the section circled in the images above as follows:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212780/2987261fafbd96881f74c389756a1a7a102255c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43212780/abfe98c2180fbf478a1be83036f568a72d5753ee.png[/img]

Once fully open, close the file cabinet, and then reopen it. This solution should allow the game to function properly. This method resolves the issue without requiring you to delete your save data. Furthermore, you can reapply this solution if the problem reoccurs.

I apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. The mentioned bug will be addressed within the coming days. We will make adjustments to prioritize preserving save data.

I would like to express my sincere gratitude to all those who have reported this issue. Thank you, thank you, thank you so much.

The continuous issue with the 'knife' was due to its nature as the first piece of evidence, causing it to be in a category that is most likely to fold up. This caused problems with all evidence items, and the game would stop when a bug occurred. Since the 'knife' is the very first item and likely to be affected, the bug was isolated to it. Save data saved me... Thank you once again...

notes.title: 08.15 Bug Patch
notes.notes:
Hello, this is 이솝, the current programmer in charge!

I previously posted a notice regarding the existing bugs in the game.
You can check it out here : https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2183320/view/5703298597488892236?

We have fixed the reported bugs, including the ones mentioned in the notice.

[b]Fixed Bugs[/b]

Bug where answer pop-ups weren't properly generated in the case log
Bug where answers weren't displayed correctly in the case log (including initialization and answer cancelation)
Issue where 'Oh Yeonwoo's 2nd Transcript' wasn't obtained → Many of you, including 'Jeonhajin', reported this. We thought this issue was fixed in the early August update, but... it occurred again. We're truly sorry. We promise it's fixed this time for real!!!
Additionally, we resolved internal errors where objects weren't properly assigned in the code.

[b]Bugs to Watch For...[/b]

Bug where only the 'Knife' evidence can be selected
We attempted to reproduce this bug along with my team members, but we couldn't replicate it...
It's a bug that can't be reproduced.
For now, we suspect that these bugs might have overlapped and caused this issue. Therefore, since we've fixed the above bugs, we hope these won't occur anymore...
If you continue to experience the same issues after this bug patch, please follow the steps below:

Save your current game progress.

Once you've saved, navigate to the folder:

C:\Users(YourUsername)\AppData\LocalLow\GamesungGames\For Your Tranquility

Please note that the username may vary based on your computer environment. If you've named your drive differently, follow that configuration.

Inside this folder, you'll find save data files corresponding to each number. If you encountered problems with a certain number's save data, please send that file to devaisopos@gmail.com .
※ There's a 0-numbered save data file, but you can ignore it. Just send the save data that corresponds to the number.
The save data contains the situation you've played through as a player. With this data, we hope to reproduce and subsequently fix the bug on our end.

Apart from the 'Knife' bug, you can use the same method for other bugs as well. So, if you encounter different bugs, please send the respective save data via email.
If you describe the situation when the bug occurred, we can respond more quickly.

Once again, we apologize for not providing a smooth gameplay experience. We hope that in this version, you'll be able to enjoy a seamless playthrough up to the final ending without any issues.

-

Additionally, unfortunately, in order to play the new version, you will need to start fresh with a new save file. If there's an opportunity to provide a separate explanation on how 'For Your Tranquility' is implemented, it would be great. But for now, let me briefly explain that the designers create a blueprint with pre-determined sentences, and the internal program of 'For Your Tranquility' generates the game based on that blueprint. The generated result is the mentioned save data file.
The game operates by recording this generated result.

Due to this implementation, if the blueprint even slightly changes... although it may appear the same, internally it creates an entirely different game. [b]This update is about modifying this blueprint...[/b]

Currently, how to modify the existing blueprint (=existing save data) for updates that modify this blueprint has not been determined. Some cases need to be preserved, some cases need to be discarded, and in some cases, we need to find workarounds and twists. There are too many possibilities... and we lack the technical capabilities. I apologize.

Again, due to these factors, in order to properly play the current bug-patched version, you will need to start a new playthrough.
While informing you of this, I hope you will confirm if the game has been properly updated (=the existing play button may have changed!) and proceed to play. Thank you!

notes.title: In the current game version, several bugs have been discovered.
notes.notes:
Hello. This is 이솝, the current programmer in charge. We have received reports of several bugs related to the current update version.

- A bug where evidence selection is possible without a knife → We are currently investigating when this bug occurs. Thank you '초개촘' and 'ZwaX3', 'Twitch Plumy', '에피네프린' for reporting.
- A bug where selected answers remain even after cancellation → You can continue playing the game by closing and reopening the file cabinet or by selecting the question again. We will fix this quickly. 
- A bug where the autopsy report answer doesn't generate → We are investigating when this bug occurs.

We apologize for the delayed response and the inconvenience caused. We will work on a patch within the next few days. We apologize once again for not providing a seamless gameplay experience. We sincerely appreciate your continued interest.

We are still accepting bug reports. Please leave them in the comments, and we will share and address them through announcements.

notes.title: 2023.07.08. Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone, who are both medical examiner and players.
Finally, the work to minimize uncomfortable experiences and improve convenience has been completed. The following are the updates:

Tutorial instructions have been added.
Story elements (evidence) and ending scenes have been included to ensure clear storytelling.
The system has been modified to automatically collect items on-site.
Some dialogues have been edited for brevity.
That's about it.
After reviewing and translating the text, we are now proceeding with the update.
I would like to express my gratitude to those who have been waiting patiently.
I hope you enjoy playing the game.
Thank you very much.

I can't tell you when the next one will go on sale, but I'll do my best to get everyone to see it as soon as possible.

Above all, we would like to express our gratitude to those who love our game.
PD Din.

notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello.
It's Gamesung Games.

It's been a while since I said hello.
In addition to the automatic storage of previous updates, updates will be made to evidence and reasoning sentences that received additional feedback.
The details are as follows.


1. Evidence submission system
[strike] Previously, one evidence was submitted to one department[/strike] 
-> The total number of times evidence can be submitted exists separately. Therefore, it is possible to submit the desired evidence within the total number of times.

2. Reasoning Sentence System
[strike]Independent and infeasible reasoning sentences[/strike]
-> The connection between the evidence must be found, and it will be improved to a reasoning sentence linked to the autopsy report.


For those who are waiting for the update,
I'd like to offer a discount during the mystery game festival.
We will update as soon as possible so that you can enjoy the game.

Thank you.

notes.title: Hello. It's Gamesung Games.
notes.notes:
Hello.
It's Gamesung Games.

We've received an astonishing number of reviews since its launch.
I realized that there are many areas that need to be improved.
Therefore, we have found a point that needs to be improved first among many improvements.
I picked two things that need to be improved urgently.

1. Automatic saving problem: I would like to correct the problem of automatically saving and blocking other information when submitting a reasoning sentence. Auto-save will not work in the game in the future.

2. Unable to select storage slots during play: Various branches will allow players to select storage slots to enjoy the game. 


The fundamental problem was to request only one department to assess evidence.
I will try to improve the problems as much as possible in the future.
Thank you for playing our game and leaving a precious review...!
I'll revise it hard and come to you with the next announcement.
I'm sorry and thank you!
